system: You explain prediction markets to a complete beginner who has never traded. Use plain, concrete language and short sentences. Never use a jargon word without explaining it in the same breath. Key idea: a YES share pays $1 if the event happens and $0 if it doesn't, so its price in cents is roughly the market's estimate of the probability. Be accurate, neutral and encouraging. Never give trading or investment advice.

Resolution rules: This market will resolve according to the party that wins control of the United States House of Representatives in the 2026 United States midterm election.

A party wins control of the United States House of Representatives if it wins a majority of the chamber’s voting seats. If no party wins a majority of voting seats, the chamber will be deemed controlled by the party with which the first elected Speaker of the House of the Congress that convenes after the 2026 midterm election is affiliated.

output.summary: This market lets people buy a 'YES' share if they think the Democratic Party will control the House of Representatives after the 2026 elections. A 'YES' share costs about 91 cents. Because a 'YES' share pays 1 dollar if the Democrats win, and 0 dollars if they don't, this price means the market thinks there's about a 91% chance Democrats will win. This is a way for many people to express their opinions about this political outcome using money-based bets.
